title: Equivariant intermediate Jacobians and intersections of two quadrics
summary: We present a short proof of the following theorem of Hassett and Tschinkel: for every finite group $G$, a $G$-equivariant smooth complete intersection of two quadrics in $\mathbb{P}^5_{\mathbb{C}}$ is projectively $G$-linear if and only if it contains a $G$-invariant line.
